name: Faiz Dzulfikar
title: Medical doctor and research assistant in cardiology
intro: I'm a medical doctor in Yogyakarta, working as a research assistant in cardiology at Universitas Gadjah Mada and Dr. Sardjito Hospital. Outside the clinic I build software for problems I run into on the ward and in research, design and edit for health campaigns, and spend my mornings at the gym, on a run, or on the tennis court.
now: Research assistant at COHARD-PH, Department of Cardiology and Vascular Medicine, UGM and Dr. Sardjito Hospital
Building tools for the COHARD-PH registry and its patients
Preparing for a master's in public health on the way to cardiology
